name: trend
description: Time-series trend analysis from sentinel history snapshots. Computes direction (rising, falling, stable), rate of change, statistical summary (min, max, mean, stddev), and flags anomalous data points. Requires at least 2 sentinel snapshots in the specified time window.

parameters.source: string (required) — Domain or metric source, e.g. "markets", "conflicts", "cyber"
parameters.metric: string (optional) — Specific metric to track within the domain, e.g. "spy_price", "event_count"
parameters.window: string (optional) — Time window for analysis, e.g. "7d", "30d" (default: "7d")

examples.description: Analyze market trends over the past week
Track conflict event count over 30 days
